title: The Parentless Melchizedek
english: Paul described Melchizedek as being without father and without lineage. That the greatest of the priests, Melchizedek, did not ascend from the earth, no one has the power to oppose; for he did not grow from an oak nor from a rock, nor, having been taken from the earth, is he fashioned according to Adam, being molded and fashioned by hand.

And shortly thereafter: What then could anyone say? For Melchizedek is recorded to us as being without father. Even if he might be pleasing to God and the Word, and the whole universe seems to us to bear his image and to preserve his character, he is not without father, nor is he without lineage; for to Christ there is both mother Mary and the royal lineage of David, and from the root of Jesse the flower of all our fragrance rises, and his fleshly lineage is genealogized, while that of Melchizedek is considered ungenealogized.

Would not someone say that Melchizedek is ungenealogized because he is not from the seed of Abraham, nor is he ever genealogized by Moses, but his race is Canaanite and he springs from that seed? And it is just regarding those appearing by themselves and not springing from ancestors, nor from any righteous seed.

It was not right, therefore, to genealogize and to trace up to the race of Canaan the one emerging into the height of righteousness, for it was not fitting to entwine the one having reached the height of righteousness with the race having reached the height of iniquity. Therefore the Scripture says that he is without lineage and without father, not regarding the ancestors as worthy of the virtue of a righteous and temperate man.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Melchizedek's Canaanite Origin and Christ's Lineage
english: That Melchizedek's race is shown to be Canaanite, it is clearly evidenced also from those whom he ruled and over whose regions he reigned; for he was closer to Sodom, and closer to Abraham dwelling by the Mamre oak. And I think also that he happened to be king of Salem, which is this much-throned Jerusalem. And shortly after.

If then Melchizedek is clearly like the Son of God, he will not be without father, nor without mother, nor without genealogy, but the things of the flesh will be genealogized according to the nature of the flesh, while something else regarding the being without genealogy will be seen, just as we also neglect the matter concerning Christ; for Christ indeed is genealogized according to the body, but according to the highest rank he has an unstated genealogy, as we have previously demonstrated.

Regarding this, Chrysostom says: Many, not having understood the things said about Melchizedek, have spoken of this one as greater than Christ and have established for themselves a heresy, who are also called Melchizedekians. Therefore, emulating and desiring to show that Melchizedek is greater than Christ, they bring to us as witness the Scripture saying: 'You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek' (Psalm 110:4). For how, he says, could he not be greater, of whom Christ priestens according to the icon and the order? But others, having been led astray, say that he is the Holy Spirit. But we say him...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Melchizedek's Nature and Type
english: He is a man sharing our passions, neither greater than Christ, nor even John the Baptist, nor is he the Holy Spirit. As for those saying that he is not greater than Christ, what kind of domain do they say he is in? Is it heavenly? Is it earthly or of the underworld?

If indeed it is a heavenly or some other domain, let them hear that every knee shall bend to him and the following [verses]. If, therefore, the knee bends, the one worshiping is lesser than the Christ who is being worshiped. But the talents do not know the following verse: to the one made unlike the Son of God, just as we also became like God according to the image.

But perhaps one of the listeners asks and says: why is it that he is called without father, without mother, and without genealogy? To those, we will say that the Jews have claimed he was born of a prostitute and because of this was not genealogized by the Scripture. To them, we will say: you have spoken badly. For we find also others born of a prostitute and having been genealogized: namely Solomon from Uriah, and then also Abimelech, the son of Gideon.

Why, then, is he not genealogized? Because he was a type of Christ and bore this icon; for this reason the Scripture left out his father and mother, so that in that icon we might behold the truly without-father, without-mother, and without-genealogy Christ.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Melchizedek as Type of Christ
english: For Christ is upon the earth according to the flesh, and without a mother in the heavens according to the Spirit according to divinity; such is the one possessing neither a beginning of days nor an end of life. For the Scripture did not record the genealogy of Melchizedek, but left behind his birth and his end, so that, just as we have said before, we might behold this one in him.

For Melchizedek is interpreted as King of Righteousness, who is Christ, possessing neither a beginning of days nor an end of life; for neither in a beginning of days was the God Word generated, nor did He ever reach an end or pass away, for Christ remains forever. Thus, Melchizedek became a righteous man and truly bore the image of God within himself; having understood that the offering to be presented to God by Christ was to be brought forward, and being moved by a prophetic spirit, he raised up God with bread and wine, imitating the coming Christ.

Since in the assembly of the Jews the order of Aaron offered sacrifice to God, not of bread and wine, but of calves and lambs, glorifying God with bloody sacrifices, God cried out toward Jesus, who was to be born from the virgin Mary, saying: 'You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek' (Psalm 110:4), not according to Aaron, who worships with bloody sacrifices, but according to the order of Melchizedek, presenting the offering of the Gentiles in bread and wine perpetually.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
